ENGLISH: My decision is taken, although I appreciate your concern,\n you will not talk me out of this Mariam…
But leaving everything you built behind like this…\n And so suddenly?
I’ve made my time, and besides,\n I’m not worried with you here in my stead.
I’ll never understand how you can be \n so resolute about everything you do.
Its easy, really, I see now what my life’s role was, \n and I intend to fulfill it.
Even if I don’t have much time left, \n I’m not afraid of death,
it is the destiny of all living beings. \n And who am I, just a man,
to challenge a fate as the universe intended for me.
No man ever steps in the same river twice?
Perhaps one day you will take a boy apprentice, \n the same way I had done for you?
I think I would like that…
